function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Contact | Pet Policy | |---------|---------|---------|------------| | **Miami Central Station** (formerly Miami Intermodal Center) | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | Phone: (305) 284‑4000
Website: [amtrak.com/stations/mia](https://www.amtrak.com/stations/mia) | **Pets are allowed on Amtrak trains** that depart from this station.
• Small dogs and cats (≤ 20 lb) can travel in a carrier or on a leash.
• Larger pets may be allowed on certain routes with prior notification.
• The station itself is fully accessible and has pet‑friendly amenities such as restrooms and seating areas.
• Always check Amtrak’s current pet‑policy before traveling. | **Why it’s pet‑friendly** - **Amtrak’s pet policy** applies to all trains that depart from Miami Central Station, so you can bring your furry friend along on the journey. - The station is a modern, fully accessible hub with ample seating, restrooms, and a convenient location near the Miami International Airport and downtown Miami. - While the station’s own rules don’t restrict pets in the building, Amtrak’s guidelines ensure that pets can travel comfortably on the train itself. If you’re planning a trip, give the station a quick call or check Amtrak’s website for the latest pet‑travel requirements and any route‑specific restrictions.
